cues.zh: 其實，這不是正確答案。

cues.en: And to prove that this is the incorrect answer, we can actually compute the the real minimum of this function analytically.
cues.zh: 要證明不正確，可以用解析方式求出真正的最小值。

cues.en: And the way we do that is by computing the derivative which we already have, we set the derivative to zero.
cues.zh: 做法是先求導數，我們已經有了，再把導數設為零。

cues.en: And then we solve for x, and we find that the true minimum of this function is x equals 0.5.
cues.zh: 然後解出 x，發現真正的最小值位於 x 等於零點五。

cues.en: So so gradient descent actually gave us an answer that was close.
cues.zh: 所以，梯度下降給的是接近的答案。

cues.en: You know I'm not saying that it was totally, totally wrong, but it is definitely not accurate.
cues.zh: 不是說它完全錯了，但確實不夠精確。

cues.en: This is not the correct solution to the minimum of this function.
cues.zh: 不是這個函式最小值的正確解。

cues.en: So there's a couple of points that I want to make here, which I'm going to expand upon quite a bit throughout the next several sections.
cues.zh: 有幾點想說，接下來幾節會詳細展開。

cues.en: But just to give you a heads up.
cues.zh: 這裡先提醒你。

cues.en: Gradient descent is not guaranteed to give us the correct solution.
cues.zh: 梯度下降不保證得到正確解。

cues.en: It's not guaranteed to give us the optimal, the best solution.
cues.zh: 不保證得到最優、最好的解。

cues.en: There are several circumstances that can make gradient descent algorithm either go completely wrong or just something like this, where we're pretty close, but we're not actually correct.
cues.zh: 有幾種情況，可能讓梯度下降完全出錯，或者像這樣，很接近卻不完全正確。

cues.en: One is using a poor choice of model parameters, so we could actually get closer to the correct solution here by changing the model parameters.
cues.zh: 第一，模型參數選得不好；調整參數，就可能更接近正確解。

cues.en: Two is we can get stuck in local minimum.
cues.zh: 第二，可能卡在局部極小值。

cues.en: I'll talk more about that in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片會再談。

cues.en: A third issue is we can run into some problems like vanishing gradients or exploding gradients.
cues.zh: 第三，可能遇到梯度消失或梯度爆炸。

cues.en: And I think that's actually probably all the things that can go wrong.
cues.zh: 我想，大概就是這些可能出錯的情況。

cues.en: So gradient descent is a great algorithm.
cues.zh: 所以，梯度下降是很棒的演算法。

cues.en: It's simple and it's very powerful.
cues.zh: 簡單又強大。

cues.en: Gradient descent is guaranteed to move us towards the direction of a good solution.
cues.zh: 梯度下降保證會朝著好解的方向移動。

cues.en: It is not necessarily guaranteed to give us the exact correct solution.
cues.zh: 但不一定保證得到完全正確的解。

cues.en: Now, fortunately, many of the problems of gradient descent have been overcome in the past decade or so or two decades of research and development in deep learning.
cues.zh: 幸好，深度學習在過去十年，或者二十年的研究與發展中，已經克服許多梯度下降的問題。

cues.en: So there are quite a few tricks that we use in deep learning that will get around some of the problems of gradient descent.
cues.zh: 所以，有很多技巧可以避開其中一些問題。

cues.en: So therefore the conclusion is that gradient descent is a great algorithm.
cues.zh: 因此，結論是，梯度下降是很棒的演算法。

cues.en: It basically always works very well.
cues.zh: 基本上，總是能運作得很好。

cues.en: It is not guaranteed to work perfectly.
cues.zh: 但不保證完美。

cues.en: And that's pretty much how gradient descent works.
cues.zh: 以上就是梯度下降的基本運作方式。

cues.en: There isn't really a lot more to it.
cues.zh: 其實沒有太多其他內容。

cues.en: There are some tricks and tips.
cues.zh: 還有一些技巧和訣竅。

cues.en: There's some parameters and implementation details, but you now understand the gradient descent algorithm.
cues.zh: 一些參數與實作細節，但你現在已經理解梯度下降演算法。
